entries.0356b2bbf1f3ced6: This is the core segment, handled by the company itself. Through housing businesses, it lends housing finance services to consumers, including Flat 35, offered in partnership with the Japan Housing Finance Agency, as well as housing loans and bridge loans. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,907 million.
entries.157dacdafdacf132: It is handled by the consolidated subsidiary Hausu Jīmen Co., Ltd. and the General Incorporated Association Housing Technology Council. As a housing defect liability insurance corporation designated by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, it sells housing defect (Kashi) insurance and also provides housing performance evaluations and ground guarantees, among others. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,374 million.
entries.38eb69993a46f74c: This cloud system supports housing businesses in DX and management rationalization, and is offered in conjunction with housing warranty services.
entries.3f7ded616328ee0e: This is a long-term warranty for structure and waterproofing that can be applied for after the end of the 10-year housing defect liability period.
entries.42697caaa2c780e5: Housing Defect Insurance and Related Business
entries.5466b519f54680bc: This is a guarantee against incidents such as uneven settlement caused by ground conditions after a house has been built.
entries.74f155fc431a0462: This is a service guaranteeing repair costs for housing equipment installed in newly built homes; the guarantee period is 10 years.
entries.8a87c4611d61b996: This is an ancillary housing loan product that covers land purchase funds for the period before the housing loan is disbursed, interim payments for construction work, and renovation costs when buying a used property, among others.
entries.8fd770366b3ddb8d: This is a statutory mandatory insurance required upon handover of newly built housing. Housing businesses are required under the Housing Defect Liability Performance Act to take insurance or deposit measures, and the insurance period is 10 years.
entries.910d9bd283c95236: This is a housing quality evaluation based on the Act on the Promotion of Ensuring Quality of Housing (Hinkakuhō), which is also used when applying for tax incentives and subsidy programs.
entries.9528f6656814a8d0: It is handled by the consolidated subsidiary Housing Akademeia Co., Ltd. It provides housing warranty services after handover and the housing business cloud system 'Sukettō Cloud', and supports housing businesses in transitioning to stock-type business and in DX. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥678 million.
entries.9fd2cf5b811ba3db: A housing finance services company that provides small and medium-sized housing businesses with home loans such as Flat 35, housing defect insurance and housing warranties, and cloud systems for housing businesses.
entries.c09f181d3b3977bc: This is the company's own proper loan, a variable-rate loan for purchasing new or used homes and for renovations. Immediately after disbursement, it is transferred in trust to a trust company, minimizing default risk.
entries.c0b546da45f8d98e: This is a fixed-rate housing loan for the whole term of up to 35 years. It secures housing quality through its own technical standards and inspections, and minimizes default risk by selling loan receivables to the Japan Housing Finance Agency.
entries.dbd0ce33d5f60023: This is a service that guarantees the costs of responding to after-sales maintenance by housing businesses; the guarantee period is 2 years.
